controls: Negative control: uniform random sign-complete subgroup factor base at matched cardinality.
Positive control: short scalar progression expected to have high additive energy.
Baseline: deterministic-restart Pollard rho on eight targets per curve using the same affine group implementation.
Random-sum model: lambda=B^5/q and predicted target success 1-exp(-lambda).
experiment.falsification_criterion: Narrow H-ECDLP-ENERGY-001 if no coordinate family simultaneously reaches 2.0x random pair energy and 1.5x random five-term success at two of three sizes, or if independent verification fails.
invalidation_rules: Generated curve is singular, supersingular, or lacks a prime subgroup q >= p/16.
A factor base is not exactly the preregistered even cardinality or is not sign-complete.
A target, relation witness, or rho logarithm fails direct curve arithmetic verification.
Any integer protocol field is supplied as a boolean or floating-point value.
Run wrapper reports a dirty working tree for the canonical measurement run.
Independent verifier does not exactly reproduce all integer counts.

primary: online group operations per target and per successful target
secondary: offline group operations and affine field operations
counter entry count and deep storage bytes
source multiplicity and recovered witness validity

experiment.objective: Measure whether concrete coordinate predicates create additive-combinatorial concentration or a useful fixed-curve five-term decomposition compiler beyond matched random sets.
stopping_rules: Stop if wall time exceeds 600 seconds or peak RSS exceeds 2 GiB.
Stop curve search after 64 coefficient attempts at any size and record the run invalid.
Do not promote on the positive control alone.
Do not fit or claim an exponent from fewer than three verified sizes.
experiment.success_criterion: Promote one coordinate family to a multi-seed scale-up only if it has at least 2.0x the random-control pair energy and 1.5x the random-control five-term target success at two of three sizes, its offline group-operation ratio is at most 4.0, every witness verifies, and the independent verifier passes. This is a preflight promotion gate, not a breakthrough criterion; the later breakthrough gate remains fitted total exponent below 0.5 with preprocessing and memory included on random curves.
experiment.title: Verification-first coordinate additive-energy and fixed-curve decomposition preflight
